description: This file contains functions and configurations for platform-specific operations such as image checking, upgrading, and copying configurations tailored to various hardware platforms in the OpenWrt/LEDE project.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the platform image based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a platform-specific upgrade operation based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies platform-specific configuration based on the board name.
